parameters.name: Usable operating space fit
parameters.rationale: Restaurant workflow and treatment rooms require different verified layouts

parameters.name: Lease obligations fit
parameters.rationale: Obligations affect all concepts; rent itself belongs to economics

parameters.name: Reachable resident population
parameters.rationale: Repeat local appointments give residents greater relevance

parameters.name: Barrier adjusted reach fit
parameters.rationale: Network access matters; population aggregation must not count reach twice

parameters.name: Target customer fit
parameters.rationale: Segment evidence matters more than demographic stereotypes

parameters.name: Repeat local customer fit
parameters.rationale: Appointment concepts depend more on repeat local relationships

parameters.name: Spending power index
parameters.rationale: Premium beauty may depend more on discretionary capacity

parameters.name: Offer affordability fit
parameters.rationale: Income needs an explicit offer-price comparison

parameters.name: Observed trading window demand fit
parameters.rationale: Coffee and dining windows require matching demand evidence

parameters.name: Verified unmet offer demand
parameters.rationale: Demand gap requires compatible supply and demand scope

parameters.name: Direct competitive pressure
parameters.rationale: Restaurant pressure can be material; counts alone are insufficient

parameters.name: Documented differentiation fit
parameters.rationale: Differentiation offsets pressure only where documented

parameters.name: Complementary trip linkage
parameters.rationale: Coffee may benefit from linked trips when paths overlap

parameters.name: Complementary hours alignment
parameters.rationale: Co-location without overlapping hours is weak

parameters.name: Comparable business momentum
parameters.rationale: Contextual stock-flow signal is not unit demand

parameters.name: Documented local change effect
parameters.rationale: Works and route changes may affect dining access and deliveries

parameters.name: Nearest useful station distance
parameters.rationale: Proximity has greater hypothesised relevance for commuter coffee

parameters.name: Useful service frequency
parameters.rationale: Frequency shares a capped group with proximity

parameters.name: Daytime resident ratio
parameters.rationale: Daytime workers matter less to a resident appointment concept

parameters.name: Verified activity timing fit
parameters.rationale: Evening restaurants need time evidence not just daytime ratios

parameters.name: Related fit-out continuity
parameters.rationale: Related equipment can matter, subject to survey and consent

parameters.name: Verified disruptive turnover pattern
parameters.rationale: Repeated changes merit scrutiny but do not establish causes

parameters.name: Base operating headroom to fixed cost
parameters.rationale: All models require defensible contribution over costs

parameters.name: Verified operating capacity fit
parameters.rationale: Covers treatment duration, seating or production bottlenecks

parameters.name: Downside result to fixed cost
parameters.rationale: Downside fragility is especially relevant to capital-intensive dining

parameters.name: Independent cost shock resilience
parameters.rationale: Requires an explicit shock output and no repeated penalty

parameters.name: Permitted use fit
parameters.rationale: Any concept must be compatible with verified permissions

parameters.name: Works and consent fit
parameters.rationale: Extraction or treatment alterations can change requirements

parameters.name: Activity permission fit
parameters.rationale: Apply only the activities actually proposed

parameters.name: Licence conditions fit
parameters.rationale: Hours/operator/premises conditions can bind the concept

parameters.name: Utilities ventilation plumbing fit
parameters.rationale: Hot kitchens and some treatments need specific infrastructure

parameters.name: Property specific hazard and access fit
parameters.rationale: Area indicators cannot replace unit assessment

parameters.name: Matched cohort persistence context
parameters.rationale: Weak transferability to one proposed business

parameters.name: Matched cohort exit context
parameters.rationale: Same cohort group cap prevents doubling survival evidence
